mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM post_comments pc JOIN users u ON u.id = pc.user_id LEFT JOIN post_comments parent ON parent.id = pc.parent_comment_id LEFT JOIN post_comments reply_target ON reply_target.id = pc.reply_to_comment_id AND reply_target.post_id = pc.post_id LEFT JOIN users reply_target_user ON reply_target_user.id = reply_target.user_id WHERE pc.post_id = #{postId} AND ( ( pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND ( pc.deleted = 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_comments reply WHERE reply.parent_comment_id = pc.id AND reply.post_id = pc.post_id AND reply.deleted = 0 ) ) ) OR ( pc.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL AND pc.deleted = 0 AND parent.id IS NOT NULL AND parent.post_id = pc.post_id AND parent.parent_comment_id IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN pc.created_at ELSE parent.created_at END ASC, CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN pc.id ELSE parent.id END ASC, CASE WHEN pc.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, pc.created_at ASC, pc.id ASC

SELECT id, post_id AS postId, user_id AS userId, parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, reply_to_comment_id AS replyToCommentId, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted_at AS deletedAt, deleted FROM post_comments WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted = 0
